## Appearance

Nell possesses a slight, small, and slender frame, standing straight-backed and an inch taller than [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md). Her sharp, bright, and freckle-dusted face features a small pointed chin, a very pretty nose, and large, starry, earnest grey eyes. Her hair is famously red, described variously as ginger, fiery, crimson, auburn, [Titian](../character/titian.md), or simply red, and is often worn in long braids or plaits. At times, her unplaited hair flows out like a radiant river, though on one occasion it mysteriously became green.

## Personality

Nell is an unusual, intelligent, and compliant young girl who possesses an unselfish nature, though she is also known for a swift temper, an undesirable tendency to harbor animosity, and a resolute stubbornness. Intensely passionate in both her affections and her hatreds, she is remarkably talkative, theatrical in her phrasing, and relies heavily on a vivid imagination to pass the time. She frequently drifts into reveries during her chores and can be overly careless and hasty. Practically skilled, she is a fast runner, writes the finest essays about field afternoons, and has learned to bake cakes, despite otherwise being unable to cook. Her ambitions include passing her exams high to make [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) proud, qualifying for and preparing for the Entrance exam, becoming a teacher, and making [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) her closest companion. Furthermore, she desires to remain at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to care for [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), even choosing to stay over attending [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) or accepting a scholarship.

## History

An orphan girl, Nell Harcourt was sent to live with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) ultimately decided to keep her despite an initial mix-up over her gender. Nell quickly formed a deep bond with [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), though her hot temper occasionally caused trouble, such as when she smashed her slate over Hugh Carrow's head for teasing her about her red hair. She also inadvertently caused a stir by mistakenly serving currant wine to Isolde and later accidentally ruining a cake for the new minister with liniment. After a fall off a kitchen roof broke her ankle, Nell recovered and eventually attempted to dye her hair green, forcing [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to crop it short. Her adventurous nature led to another disaster when she acted out a story on a pond in a leaking boat, requiring [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) to rescue her from the water. Nell later excelled academically under her teacher Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md), winning top marks on the island on her Regent's entrance exam and overcoming severe stage fright to deliver a lauded recitation at a charity concert. Following her move to Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), Nell was devastated when [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) suddenly passed away after a bank failure. Learning that [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) was losing her vision and faced with the prospect of selling [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), Nell gave up her college scholarship to take a local teaching job at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school to support [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). After discovering that [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) had selflessly withdrawn his own application for the position so she could have it, Nell reconciled with him, contentedly accepting her new future at home.

## Quotes

> "If you were a parentless child who arrived at a spot expected to be your home, only to discover you were undesired for not being a male, you would weep as well. Oh, my life has never known a more calamitous event!"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "yet, oh, I beg you to address me as Lucinda. What name you use for me cannot be of great importance to you if my stay is to be merely brief, can it? Besides, Nell is a name so lacking in romance."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why failed you to inform me at the depot that I was unwanted and abandon me at that place? Had I not observed the Petal Road of Delight and the Lake of Glassy Waters, this would be less difficult."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She acquired Lily Jones for her own. Lily has reached just five years of age and is extremely beautiful, possessing nut-brown hair. Were I extremely beautiful with nut-brown hair, would you retain me?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "In what way is it possible for you to term the night good, given your awareness that it has to be the most terrible one I have ever experienced?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P49](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby have a stormy initial relationship marked by Mrs. Sowerby mocking Nell's plain appearance and red hair, which drives Nell into a violent rage. After refusing at first, Nell is convinced by [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to deliver a humble apology to Mrs. Sowerby, who forgives her and gives her hope about her hair. Over time, Mrs. Sowerby offers advice on handling Nell's temper, and she later compliments Nell's growth, grace, and academic achievements despite her initial misgivings.

### [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-lavinia--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell first encounters [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) by inadvertently jumping onto her bed late at night while staying at Isolde's house. To prevent the furious old woman from leaving, Nell takes full responsibility for the prank and wins [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) over with her honesty and charm. The two form a fond friendship, leading [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) to host Nell and Isolde at her home, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), for a week of sightseeing, exhibition visits, and concerts.

### [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/hugh-carrow--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell's dynamic with her classmate [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) is tense and complex, stemming from an incident where he teased her about her red hair and pulled it, prompting her to smash her slate over his head. Although Hugh harbors an infatuation with her, silently competes with her academically, and later rescues her in a dory, Nell stubbornly refuses to forgive him or speak to him for a long period, though she eventually feels a hint of regret for her harshness.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), +16 more_

### [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/isolde-pembroke--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell and [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) are devoted best friends who swear eternal loyalty to one another shortly after their first meeting at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill). They share constant companionship, walking to school together, attending social events, and comforting each other through dramatic imagined heartbreaks and medical emergencies, such as when Nell helped save Isolde's infant sister. Their deep bond persists as close schoolmates, though Nell occasionally grieves when academic paths threaten to separate them.
